text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Princess. You can become the queen. It'll 
be fine, go share your feelings with 
everyone."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Princess. You can become the queen. It'll 
be fine, go share all your feelings with 
everyone."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, Dark Princess... No, I shall deliver 
these feelings to my friends as well."

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"‘So please, watch me. Watch me shine as 
your queen!’"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...It has finally arrived. The Queen 
Elizabeth II Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
H-Hyah, Trainer! What should I do? In 
th-this race, I...
choice_data_list: Shall we take a deep breath?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Even if it was just a tiny bit.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you're super stiff! Even though you 
said taking 1st place would be 'a breeze'.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Can you even run in that state? Guess this 
year's back-to-back victory is mine for 
the taking, huh?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Wha-!? I won't give up 1st place! I'll 
leave your jaw hanging wide open!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Just try it if you think you can. Fufu, 
I'll be looking forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I am going to win! As a princess, 
winning the dream race is what it's all 
about!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I am deee-finitely not going to lose to 
Sweep-san!!

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
—It's beginning again this year, isn't it? 
That splendid race symbolizing strength, 
glamour, and beauty.

text_block_list.name: Madam Wearing a Hat
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Furthermore, I would love to see the 
crowning of Umamusume worthy of being 
queens, just like Mejiro Dober and Fine 
Motion.

text_block_list.name: Lady in a Dress
text_block_list.text:
That's true... I just hope a girl appears 
this year whom I can truly praise as a 
Queen from the bottom of my heart...
